breakdown.reason: The generated specification still instructs converting Q_v to J/mol (keeping it molar) and then using the formula n_v = N exp(-Q_v / (k_B * T)). This perpetuates the original mixing of a molar activation energy with the per-particle Boltzmann constant. The correct resolution would be to use n_v = N exp(-Q_v / (R * T)) with molar Q_v, or to convert Q_v to a per-atom value (divide by N_A) before using k_B. Neither correction was made.
